question: Pilot (#11323): does the Haiku briefer (BH: filefind candidates without the card decision, then a constrained Haiku agent) keep B0's success while naming more of the fix's files, and what do its own seconds and dollars add?
issue_selection: Six S2 issues on which at least one S2 trial was accepted (so a difference can show), chosen before any BH trial. A pilot, not a claim: S2's own A and B0 trials on these issues are the larger baseline.

pins.agent_source: crates/briefed-agent at 616c6f79d0 (main, release build on the environment)
pins.host: oa-dev-env-4 (GCE c3-standard-22 spot, us-central1-b): agents, worktrees, the Haiku stage, builds and grading on one machine (AB_HOST=local), one build checkout, prewarm per issue
pins.login: the owner's Claude Code subscription token from Secret Manager (dev-env-session.sh)

budget_rule: Agent trials (with the Haiku stage's own cost) stop at $45 of CLI-reported list price; a stopped run is reported as incomplete.
outcome: accepted = the fix commit's own tests pass on the change and the blind judge accepts (score >= 4), as S2.
refrozen: 2026-10-11, before any hb1 trial: re-pinned for a cloud dev environment (the Mac and coderos-4080 pins could not be met). Issues, arms, reps, seed, levers, budget and outcome are unchanged.
